# LoadSaathi

## About
LoadSaathi operates an online marketplace connecting truck owners and drivers with shippers needing cargo transport across India. The platform displays real-time available loads allowing fleet operators to select routes matching their trucks and schedules while shippers receive quick responses from nearby carriers. It targets mid-size and small trucking businesses often lacking direct contacts for better paying trips and includes features for checking rates distances and payments before booking. The service handles payments through the platform to minimize cash issues and learns common routes to suggest return loads reducing empty runs mainly in states like Maharashtra Gujarat Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.

**Areas of Work:** Transportation, Mobility & Logistics, Logistics Software, Freight Matching, Trucking Marketplace

## Services

- **In-app Payments** (Included in platform fee): Secure payment handling to avoid cash disputes at delivery
- **Route Suggestions** (Included in platform): Smart suggestions for return loads based on learned routes
